```{r}
#| include: false

library(ggplot2)

# Simulated data for educational purposes
ratings <- data.frame(
  Category = c(
    "Food Quality",
    "Service Quality",
    "Physical Environment"
  ),
  Average = c(4.3, 4.5, 4.1)
)
```

## Row

### Project Overview

This dashboard explores customer experience and satisfaction at
The Restaurant at Kellogg Ranch (RKR), as part of my
MSDM Culminating Experience Project at Cal Poly Pomona.

**Research objective:** Identify what customers value most
and where improvements could enhance their dining experience.

**Important:** All numerical results displayed here are
simulated examples for educational purposes, not actual
RKR customer survey findings.

## Row

### Customer Experience Ratings

```{r}

#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5
#| out-width: "100%"

ggplot(ratings,
       aes(x = reorder(Category, Average),
           y = Average)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#355D87", width = 0.55) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Average),
    hjust = -0.3,
    size = 5
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 5),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Customer Experience Ratings",
    subtitle = "Simulated survey results",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Average Rating (1–5)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```

## Row

### Research Focus

My research evaluates customer perceptions of:

- Food quality, including taste and freshness
- Service quality, including friendliness and attentiveness
- Physical environment, including cleanliness and comfort
- Overall customer satisfaction
- Intention to return
- Likelihood to recommend

The goal is to translate customer feedback into
actionable recommendations that can support service
improvements and marketing decisions.
